intent: An owner whose credit runs out mid-batch gets every owed answer once they top up and resume.
observable_outcome: get-context batch lists both rules as reviewed, proven by their tests.

acceptance_criteria.statement: When Run refuses a simulated person's answer because the owner's credit or run quota ran out, the batch pauses with that reason instead of closing the trial; a paused batch answers nothing, and resuming it gives the answers still owed.
A batch is marked settled only once none of its trials is still running or owed an answer; a paused batch is neither answered nor settled until it is resumed.
